notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for ordinary attribute ownership-acquisition cancellation. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, model FOM, endpoint, time representation, and callback configuration. Two distinct adapter-configured transferable attributes are held by the owner. It verifies the canonical §7.15.3(e)/§7.15.5(d) unknown-object exception using a valid handle registered before requester subscription, pre-request and already-owned exception boundaries, rejection of a cancellation when only an If Available request exists, a subsequent regular two-attribute acquisition followed by cancelAttributeOwnershipAcquisition, exactly one confirmAttributeOwnershipAcquisitionCancellation callback containing both qualifying attributes, absence of an acquisition notification, stable ownership of both attributes, and rejection of a repeated cancellation. The grouped, at-most-once confirmation maps pinned page-171-l52-13 to §7.16. In evoked mode it also checks that the regular request supersedes pending If Available without a stale unavailable callback, that owner callback servicing after cancellation delivers no stale release request, that unpublication is fenced with OwnershipAcquisitionPending until confirmation, and that another If Available request is rejected as AttributeAlreadyBeingAcquired while cancellation remains pending. Unpublication succeeds after confirmation. The pre-confirmation If Available exclusion maps pinned page-153-l75-24 to §7.1.2.2; the unknown-object exception, stale owner release check, publication fence, and earlier If Available-only cancellation exception are API-contract observations without separate pinned Requirements Lab candidate mappings. It does not assert provider-specific callback timing, MOM reports, DDM, timestamped delivery, save/restore, or interoperability.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador attributeOwnershipAcquisition and cancelAttributeOwnershipAcquisition with FederateAmbassador requestAttributeOwnershipRelease, confirmAttributeOwnershipAcquisitionCancellation, and attributeOwnershipAcquisitionNotification callbacks
